candidate_rule: two non-promoted candidates per record: verified official fact or deterministic rounded-snapshot time-series metric, plus explicit scope guard

scope_guards.monthly_snapshot: BDUK monthly values are rounded management-information snapshots limited to initial contract scope, with variable ingestion lag. They do not establish exact-address completion, current availability, orderability or contractual milestone compliance.
scope_guards.time_series_metric: Ten-month minima, maxima, means, medians, standard deviations, direction counts and classifications are deterministic calculations over displayed rounded values for 35 comparable contract labels. Scope revisions, resubmissions and ingestion timing can drive movement; the metrics are not official statistics, forecasts, supplier-performance verdicts or parcel-level claims.
scope_guards.mobile_reception_scope: Coverage checkers and reception guidance are indicative. Actual service depends on network, device, building, terrain, vehicle, time and location and is not guaranteed at a particular point.
scope_guards.switching_scope: Mobile switching and porting guidance describes standard processes. Charges, timing, eligibility and compensation depend on provider, contract and case facts.
scope_guards.unwanted_contact_scope: Unwanted-contact guidance distinguishes nuisance communications from scams and provides reporting routes; it does not determine legality or identify a specific sender as fraudulent.
scope_guards.scam_rules_scope: Ofcom's provider rules describe sector obligations and protections; they do not prove that a particular message is fraudulent or that a specific provider has breached a rule.

expansion_rule: Join verified monthly contract seeds by normalized contract name. Retain exactly the 35 contracts with all ten monthly built values. Emit eighteen time-series records per contract: observed-month count, minimum, maximum, range, mean, median, population standard deviation, minimum month, maximum month, increase count, decrease count, unchanged count, longest non-decreasing run, direction-change count, total absolute movement, first-to-last net movement, coefficient of variation, and a volatility classification. Append 70 Ofcom records. Every fifth record is REVALIDATION; all others are UPGRADE.
